messages:
maria: FYI — Acme reported that after applying promo code PROMO2026 then reopening the promo window and reapplying, their trial credits didn’t decrement for generation API calls. They see 200s, usage tokens show 0 delta. 3 customers affected.

dan: Can you paste example request/response + customer org id?

maria: Org: acme-sre-42
Request:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/generate \
 -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-..." \
 -H "X-Request-Id: req-abc-123" \
 -d '{"model":"redwood-1","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hi"}]}'
```
Response:
```json
{"id":"chat-xyz","status":200,"usage":{"input_tokens":5,"output_tokens":12},"billing":{"charged_tokens":0}}
```

liam: hm — charged_tokens 0 while usage non-zero. Any trace_id or ledger nonce? Also did they hit the promo reapply flow (window_reopen flag)?

maria: trace_id: trace-20260317-7
logs snippet:
```
INFO apply_promo: promo PROMO2026 reapply=true user=acme-sre-42 -> ledger_alias=promo-2026
INFO finalize_charge: computed_tokens=17 ledger_key=promo-2026 commit_skipped=true
```

liam: that commit_skipped=true is suspicious. Could be alias collision where finalize sees an existing pending commit and skips. Possible race between reapply and charge finalizer.

dan: Opening billing-ops ticket and tagging ledger team. jira: RED-4219. cc @liam

ops-bot: Ticket RED-4219 created in billing-ops. Priority: high. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RED-4219

liam: For next steps: can you get raw ledger write events around trace-20260317-7 and the db row for ledger_alias=promo-2026? also whether idempotency keys are being reset on reapply.

maria: will fetch and paste in RED-4219, and send affected customer credit adjustment once we confirm. Thanks.

dan: Assigning to billing-ops and eng-billing. I'll follow up with customer.

maria: :thumbsup:
